jobs.title: Salesforce Business Analyst
jobs.why: Excellent match for Audrey's Salesforce and business-systems track: client discovery, requirements gathering, user stories, functional specifications, process flows, integrations, Agile delivery, and collaboration with configurators, developers, and project managers. Salesforce certifications are preferred rather than required.
jobs.gap: The posting asks for 3-5 years of Salesforce BA experience specifically in consulting or professional services, so Audrey should make her closest Salesforce implementation and client-facing delivery experience explicit.

jobs.title: Sr. Salesforce Business Analyst
jobs.location: Long Island City / New York, NY (Hybrid)
jobs.why: Very strong local Salesforce/BA match involving complex workflows, business requirements, project planning, reporting, technical assistance, and stakeholder support. The hybrid Long Island City location also fits Audrey's target geography especially well.
jobs.gap: The Senior title may raise the experience bar. Audrey should emphasize end-to-end requirements ownership, Salesforce delivery, UAT, workflow improvements, and examples where she independently drove a business-system change.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.why: One of today's best UX opportunities for Audrey: it targets roughly 1-3 years, combines user research, complex workflow simplification, prototyping, Figma, direct user feedback, data-informed design, and Product/Engineering collaboration. The role also explicitly uses AI prototyping tools such as Claude, Codex, and Cursor.
jobs.gap: Audrey needs portfolio case studies that clearly demonstrate end-to-end product thinking, polished Figma work, user research, and how she simplified a complex workflow rather than only showing visual design.

jobs.title: Product Operations Manager
jobs.why: Strong Product/Business Operations match in healthcare technology: coordinating launches, documentation, cross-functional sign-off, product metrics, post-release analysis, OKR tracking, AI-ready knowledge systems, and improving delivery processes all map well to Audrey's operations and systems strengths.
jobs.gap: This is a manager-level Product Ops role and some versions of the posting indicate a preference for several years of product operations/program experience. Audrey should quantify ownership, launches, process improvements, and cross-functional leadership to offset the title gap.

jobs.title: Sr. Business Systems Analyst, Salesforce Quote-to-Cash
jobs.why: Excellent functional overlap with business systems analysis: requirements, process definition, fit-gap analysis, testing, documentation, Agile delivery, reporting, Salesforce Flow, stakeholder management, and AI-assisted workflow improvement. It is fully remote in the U.S.
jobs.gap: This is a stretch role: CrowdStrike asks for 5+ years supporting SaaS business systems and at least 2 years of hands-on Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud, or another CPQ application. Apply only if Audrey can credibly demonstrate adjacent Quote-to-Cash/CPQ experience.
